import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Winkel der drei kubischen Wurzeln
k = np.arange(3)
theta = 2 * np.pi * k / 3

# Radien
r1 = 1
r2 = np.cbrt(6)

# Lösungen von z^3 = 1
x1 = r1 * np.cos(theta)
y1 = r1 * np.sin(theta)

# Lösungen von z^3 = 6
x2 = r2 * np.cos(theta)
y2 = r2 * np.sin(theta)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 7))

t = np.linspace(0, 2*np.pi, 500)

# Kreise
ax.plot(r1*np.cos(t), r1*np.sin(t), linestyle="--")
ax.plot(r2*np.cos(t), r2*np.sin(t), linestyle="--")

# Achsen
ax.axhline(0, linewidth=1)
ax.axvline(0, linewidth=1)

# Punkte
ax.scatter(x1, y1)
ax.scatter(x2, y2)

# Beschriftungen
for j in range(3):
    ax.text(
        1.12*x2[j],
        1.12*y2[j],
        rf"$z_{j}$",
        ha="center",
        va="center"
    )

    ax.text(
        1.18*x1[j],
        1.18*y1[j],
        rf"$z_{j+3}$",
        ha="center",
        va="center"
    )

ax.set_xlabel("Re")
ax.set_ylabel("Im")

lim = 2.5
ax.set_xlim(-lim, lim)
ax.set_ylim(-lim, lim)

ax.set_aspect("equal")
ax.grid(alpha=0.3)

plt.show()
